organization.discoveryNotes: Logistics template: multi-branch fleet, warehouse ops, and NCA-aligned security baseline.

workflows.name: Shipment dispatch approval
workflows.description: Dispatcher submits route plan; fleet manager approves before release.

workflows.name: Warehouse goods receipt
workflows.description: GRN capture, quality check, and inventory update.

workflows.name: Incident escalation (CyberCrow)
workflows.description: Security or operational incident routed to compliance owner.

securityRequirements.requirement: MFA for all admin and dispatcher accounts
Audit logging on shipment status changes
Role-based access to customer PII in CRM
NCA ECC alignment for identity and access

integrations.notes: Corporate SSO for HQ and hub staff
Optional ERP for finance and inventory sync
Fleet routing and ETA for dispatch

experienceRequirements.requirement: KPI dashboard: on-time delivery, fleet utilization, open incidents
Branch ops view with approvals queue and team workload
Mobile-first dispatch list; minimal navigation; large touch targets

identity.ssoNotes: Logistics template: Entra ID for HQ/hub; MFA mandatory for admins and dispatchers.

security.complianceNotes: Fleet telematics and customer data subject to PDPL; segment warehouse vs CRM access.
